KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. nene

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mazungumzo.
